title: Черепаховый суп и долг Шефа  (Turtle Soup and the Chef's Debt)

scenes.title: The Flood at Sasha's Place
scenes.summary: Max reflects on how everyone follows their own path in life until Sasha's angry landlady bursts in and discovers they have flooded the downstairs neighbor's newly renovated apartment.

scenes.title: News of Nagiyev and the Chef's Illness
scenes.summary: Max promises to help Sasha clean up the flooded apartment before heading to Claude Monet, where Nagiyev announces that he and Kristina are back together and that Chef Barinov is in the hospital.

scenes.title: A Kitchen Without Its Captain
scenes.summary: Nagiyev uses a broomstick parable to rally the cooks while Vika warns him that banquet guests are already canceling after hearing Chef Barinov is away.

scenes.title: Sasha Gets Evicted from Her Apartment
scenes.summary: Sasha tells Max at the bar that her landlady evicted her over the flood damage, while Nastya pulls Kostya aside with an unexpected request.

scenes.title: The VIP Guest's Assistant
scenes.summary: An assistant to an influential boss arrives at Claude Monet to arrange a special dinner for tomorrow, and Vika tries to keep her from going into the kitchen to see the Chef.

scenes.title: Lyova Playing the Role of the Chef
scenes.summary: When the VIP's assistant sneaks into the kitchen looking for the head chef, Vika and the cooks push Lyova into Barinov's office to impersonate Viktor Petrovich.

scenes.title: The Order for Turtle Soup
scenes.summary: Impressed by Lyova's grumpy act, the assistant hands over a live turtle and demands that the kitchen prepare exotic turtle soup for her boss tomorrow.

scenes.title: Nastya Rescues the Turtle
scenes.summary: Horrified that the live turtle is meant for soup, Nastya begs Fedya to give the creature to her, and Fedya agrees to fake the soup using chicken marinated in fish broth.

scenes.title: Sasha Moves In with Max and Kostya
scenes.summary: Max invites Sasha to move into his and Kostya's apartment, and she immediately makes herself at home while Kostya awkwardly walks in on them.

scenes.title: Pashka the Turtle and the Creditors' Visit
scenes.summary: Nastya brings the rescued turtle home to Kostya's apartment, while back at Claude Monet two intimidating men arrive looking for Chef Barinov.

scenes.title: Someone Else's Hundred-Thousand Debt
scenes.summary: Still pretending to be Chef Barinov in the office, Lyova is confronted by a loan shark who demands repayment of a hundred-thousand gambling debt.

scenes.title: Pooling Money to Save Lyova
scenes.summary: Terrified after the debt collector threatens him, Lyova panics in the kitchen until the cooks agree to chip in ten thousand rubles each to cover the Chef's debt.

scenes.title: The Kitchen Pool and a Crowded Apartment
scenes.summary: Max collects the remaining money from Senya for Lyova's debt pool, and later discovers at home that Sasha has filled the bathroom with laundry and packed all his clothes into one box.

scenes.title: Rubles Instead of Dollars and Pashka's Disappearance
scenes.summary: Lyova hands the collected hundred thousand rubles to the debt collector only to learn the debt is in dollars, while Nastya brings the turtle back to the kitchen and loses track of it.

scenes.title: Advice to Flee the City
scenes.summary: Vika scolds Nastya for bringing the turtle back into the restaurant, and the cooks advise a desperate Lyova to flee town before nightfall since nobody has a hundred thousand dollars.

scenes.title: Tempted by Borrowed Money
scenes.summary: Holding the returned pool of cash, Max lies to Lyova that he needs the money for his mother's gift and then tells Sasha he found the money to pay off her landlady.

scenes.title: Sasha's Decision and a Call from the Hospital
scenes.summary: Sasha realizes Max wants her out of his apartment and decides to move out on her own, while the hospital calls Vika to report a suspicious man asking about Chef Barinov.

scenes.title: Pashka's Escape and the Fake Soup
scenes.summary: While Fedya finishes cooking the fake turtle soup made from chicken, Nastya panics when she realizes Pashka the turtle has vanished from his box.

scenes.title: Serving the Soup and Salvation at the Crossroads
scenes.summary: The VIP guest turns out to be the man Chef Barinov owed a hundred thousand dollars to, and after Pashka crawls across the floor, the boss forgives the debt in exchange for the soup.
